title: SAVA 2026 A7L R08 current specifications
notes: Current exact 2026 A7L manufacturer page identifies R08 T800 frame, fork and seatpost, approximately 8.6 kg complete weight, and a mixed SENSAH/EMPIRE PRO hydraulic-control and Shimano 105 R7100 derailleur 2x12 build. The manufacturer describes improved rigidity and light weight without publishing a quantitative stiffness result.
